title: ColumnData
description: ColumnData: Collection of column configurations that together define the columns required to support a floor design. Each configuration gives the column required for a particular number of supported stories.

ColumnConfiguration.description: Column configurations available for the floor design. Each configuration gives the column required to support a particular number of stories at a given floor height.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
